summary: Slime and magma cube spawners crash the game
description: The bug When you put a slime egg into a spanner, it crashes your game, and when you try to get on the same world, it crashes the game until you break it. How to reproduce - give s minecraft:spawner - give s minecraft:slime_spawn_egg - Place down the spawner - Right click it with the spawn egg Game crashes Crash report 19w35a : [ crash-2019-09-02_03.56.07-client.txt] Description: Rendering Block Entity java.lang.IllegalArgumentException: Attribute is already registered! at akr.b(SourceFile:29) at akt.b(SourceFile:30) at awf.a(SourceFile:89) at awf.a(SourceFile:341) at bib.d(SourceFile:256) at drb.a(SourceFile:20) at drb.a(SourceFile:15) at drb.a(SourceFile:10) at dqq.a(SourceFile:139) at dqq.a(SourceFile:121) at dow.a(SourceFile:606) at dos.b(SourceFile:840) at dos.a(SourceFile:747) at dos.a(SourceFile:613) at czq.e(SourceFile:941) at czq.b(SourceFile:402) at net.minecraft.client.main.Main.main(SourceFile:194) A detailed walkthrough of the error, its code path and all known details is as follows: --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Head -- Thread: Render thread Stacktrace: at akr.b(SourceFile:29) at akt.b(SourceFile:30) at awf.a(SourceFile:89) at awf.a(SourceFile:341) at bib.d(SourceFile:256) at drb.a(SourceFile:20) at drb.a(SourceFile:15) at drb.a(SourceFile:10) -- Block Entity Details -- Details: Name: minecraft:mob_spawner bwb Block: Block{minecraft:spawner} Block location: World: (-53,63,0), Chunk: (at 11,3,0 in -4,0; contains blocks -64,0,0 to -49,255,15), Region: (-1,0; contains chunks -32,0 to -1,31, blocks -512,0,0 to -1,255,511) Block: Block{minecraft:spawner} Block location: World: (-53,63,0), Chunk: (at 11,3,0 in -4,0; contains blocks -64,0,0 to -49,255,15), Region: (-1,0; contains chunks -32,0 to -1,31, blocks -512,0,0 to -1,255,511) Stacktrace: at dqq.a(SourceFile:139) at dqq.a(SourceFile:121) at dow.a(SourceFile:606) at dos.b(SourceFile:840) at dos.a(SourceFile:747)
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Launch Minecraft Java Edition 19w35a.
2. Create a new Creative world with default settings.
3. Use the command `/give @p minecraft:spawner` to obtain a mob spawner item.
4. Use the command `/give @p minecraft:slime_spawn_egg` to obtain a slime spawn egg.
5. Place the mob spawner on the ground.
6. Right-click the placed mob spawner with the slime spawn egg.
7. Observe that the game crashes immediately after right-clicking the spawner with the slime spawn egg.
8. Attempt to load the world again and observe that the game continues to crash until the spawner is removed or broken.
Observed Behavior:
When a slime egg is placed into a mob spawner, the game crashes immediately. Attempting to load the same world after this crash will continue to cause the game to crash until the problematic spawner is removed or broken. The steps to reproduce this bug are as follows: First, give the player a `minecraft:spawner` and a `minecraft:slime_spawn_egg`. Next, place down the spawner in the world and right-click it with the slime spawn egg. This action will cause the game to crash due to an issue with rendering the block entity.

The specific error encountered is a `java.lang.IllegalArgumentException` indicating that an attribute has already been registered. The detailed stack trace from the crash report includes several method calls, such as `akr.b`, `akt.b`, and `awf.a`, which point to issues within the game's code related to rendering block entities.

The bug occurs at coordinates World: (-53,63,0), Chunk: (at 11,3,0 in -4,0; contains blocks -64,0,0 to -49,255,15), Region: (-1,0; contains chunks -32,0 to -1,31, blocks -512,0,0 to -1,255,511). This location is where the mob spawner was placed and subsequently caused the crash.

To assist developers in understanding and resolving this issue, it's important to include all relevant information from the crash report, including the detailed walkthrough of the error code path. Additionally, capturing before-and-after screenshots and compressing the game’s `debug` folder into a ZIP archive can provide valuable context for debugging purposes.
Expected Behavior: When a slime egg is placed into a mob spawner, the game should not crash. Instead, the spawner should successfully be set to spawn slimes or magma cubes without any issues. The player should be able to load and play in the world normally, with the spawner functioning as intended to spawn the specified mobs.
